s1.text:
How to read this canvas

- Every screen is built from the approved HalalGoes components (AppBar, BottomNav, Button, IconButton, Card, Badge, Icon, StatusTimeline, Countdown, Price, HalalBadge, Sheet, Menu, RadioGroup, Checkbox). Text uses the type role classes (type-heading-xl, type-body-md, …), never raw sizes.
- Colours, type and focus come only from the design system's own tokens.css (installed under ds/). There are no local token overrides on this canvas.
- Grey boxes with a mono tag are placeholders. "Component gap: X" means the design system has no X yet and nothing is drawn for it (MapView, Avatar, FileUpload, the bar-only Countdown). "Needs API: X" means the contract has no data or operation for it, so it is not designed as real.
- "Proposed component: X" marks a composite that IS drawn, built only from library parts (shadcn/ui on web, React Native Reusables on native) plus HalalGoes components and tokens. Each goes to the owner for approval into the design system.
- Grey boxes tagged "Annotation" are notes for reviewers and developers. Nothing in them ships; only the text outside them is customer copy.
- The brand-orange ring drawn around one control per screen is the focus indicator, drawn on purpose.
- Sample data only: Zaytoun Grill, order HG-8F3K2Q, rider Yusuf A. Every amount is a server field shown through Price; nothing is added up or subtracted on the phone.
- Headings: on every screen the state is the page's only h1 (the AppBar title is not the page heading). Times, ETAs and codes are aria-hidden where drawn, with a visually hidden sentence carrying the spoken form.
- Copy rule: no pronouns for the rider. The rider profile has only first name, last initial, photo and vehicle, so the app cannot know. Use the first name ("Yusuf") or "your rider".
- No choice is made for the customer: cancel reasons, report reason and card choice all open empty; pressing the action with nothing chosen shows the field error and moves focus there.

s10.text:
Contract notes for developers

- createRefund: 409 REFUND_ALREADY_REQUESTED, REFUND_WINDOW_CLOSED (48 h after delivery), PAYMENT_NOT_REFUNDABLE, REFUND_EXCEEDS_CAPTURED; 422 for OTHER without a note. RefundInput.lines is required for PARTIAL_ITEMS (order_line_no, quantity; no amounts).
- "Charged" is OrderPayment.amount_captured_cents; "Total" is OrderMoney.total_cents.
- The receipt exists only when completed_at is set.
- getOrderRating and submitOrderRating are a later release and are not called at launch.

s11.text:
Where focus goes (the accessibility spec's focus rules)

- Arrival: every outcome, sent, submitted, not-found and empty screen moves focus to the page h1 (tabindex=-1), drawn there. Focus is never moved on a data refresh or a server push (Outcome-Timeout arrives by push).
- Errors: when an error replaces what the customer was acting on, focus moves to the error itself (the error h1, or the error banner with tabindex=-1), never to Try again.
- Confirm sheets: focus lands on the least destructive action (Keep my order, Not now), never on the destructive button.
- Form errors: focus moves to the error summary or the invalid field group (a RadioGroup or Rating gets tabindex="-1" on its root so it can take focus); submit buttons are never disabled for validation: they stay enabled and validate on press; field errors are linked with aria-describedby, not live regions.

s2.text:
Owner decisions applied here (28 September)

- No package seals at launch (moved to v1.1): the seal screens, the report-a-broken-seal flow and every seal line are gone.
- Rating is a later release: no rating screens and no Rate action anywhere; View receipt is the primary action on a completed order.
- Support: a phone line during set hours only, self-serve outside them (GetHelp-Contact, GetHelp-Contact-Closed). No message thread.
- Bottom navigation Home · Search · Orders · Account, no bell until Alerts ships, so no copy points to Alerts: it says "We'll let you know".
- The customer app follows the phone's light or dark setting: the dark boards ship.
- Waiting for the restaurant: one neutral bar plus the absolute time ("Zaytoun Grill replies by 6:45 pm").
- Offline, a cached halal status shows only while it is 15 minutes old or less (Track-Offline-HalalStale).
- The receipt shows "Service fee $0.00".
- One active order at a time.
- Riders see the tip before accepting (the contract as it is); nothing here says otherwise.
- No rider found: the customer gets a full refund; the platform absorbs it.
- The drafted trust and halal wording is approved.

Owner decisions applied here (1 October)

- Times are 12-hour everywhere ("7:10–7:20 pm"), on every board.
- The delivery code shows on the order (Track-FullScroll) and on the tracking screens at the door (Track-Arrived-Met, -Lobby and the overdue pair). The launch fallback boards without a code are gone.
- An order under review doesn't count as the one active order: the customer can order elsewhere meanwhile (Orders-Disputed, Outcome-Disputed-Restaurant).
- Get help opens Report a problem from acceptance, with reasons that fit before delivery: very late, wrong address, want to cancel (GetHelp-Report-Early).
- The server switches phone support off outside its hours; the app shows the hours text (GetHelp-Contact-Closed). No open-now API.
- After an unpaid order is cancelled, expires or fails payment, "Put these items back in your cart" refills the cart with the existing cart operations (Outcome-PaymentExpired, Outcome-CaptureFailed, Outcome-Failed, Outcome-CancelledByYou, Outcome-CancelledByYou-Created, Outcome-Rejected-Item, the Payment-ChooseCard sheets, Cancel-Reason-ChooseCard, Track-PaymentFailed). Putting back, failed and other-restaurant states: Checkout-cancelled on the Cart canvas.
- The Expiring soon badge reads "Halal certified · expires 5 Oct" (design-system ask; Track-Waiting-ExpiringSoon).

Still open for the owner

1. When a restaurant cannot finish an order, is the customer always refunded in full? Outcome-Disputed-Restaurant says so.
2. Report a problem, late delivery: send fees only and hide "Which part of the order?"? Until decided, the question shows with nothing chosen.
3. Refund under review: show the requested amount (it exists from creation), or keep hiding it until approved (current)?
4. ETA window: we render eta_at to eta_at + window. Is the window centred on eta_at instead?

s3.text:
Contract conflicts to resolve (owner + API team)

1. The delivery code for met handovers (ProofOfDeliveryInput.otp_code) is on no customer schema or event. Owner decision (1 October): add it to the customer order view, plus a push when the rider arrives, before launch. Track-Arrived-Met, -Lobby and Track-FullScroll draw it; they carry Needs API until the contract has the field.

2. Evidence photos on the report-a-problem form (createRefund evidence_object_ids) need an upload purpose a customer may use; the only fitting one (proof of delivery) is rider-only.

3. Rider rating: the rider profile and the dispatch.assigned event carry rating_avg, but the customer-app spec says rider ratings are never shown to customers, and its rider-profile acceptance test asserts no rating_avg on GET /orders/:id/rider. The canvas follows the spec. File a contract change to drop rating_avg from both.

4. An order under review (DISPUTED) doesn't count as the one active order (owner decision, 1 October), but getActiveOrder says "the one active order" and 409 ACTIVE_ORDER_EXISTS has no exception. Contract description change: getActiveOrder and 409 ACTIVE_ORDER_EXISTS exclude DISPUTED. The Orders Active section comes from listOrders(status_group=ACTIVE), which still lists it (Orders-Default, Orders-Disputed).

s4.text:
Needs API on this canvas

- Delivery code on the customer order view and a push when the rider arrives (MEET_AT_DOOR, MEET_IN_LOBBY): owner approved for launch, not in the contract yet.
- A report reason for a wrong delivery address (sent as OTHER with a note until then).
- Masked rider contact: on every arrival board.
- Customer evidence-photo upload purpose.
- PAYMENT_FAILED customer cancel reason (or a reasonless cancel from CREATED).
- Retry payment on a CREATED order with a new payment_method_id.
- Halal state at order time on OrderCustomerView.
- order.restaurant_certification_changed event.
- Dispute resolution outcome and note on OrderCustomerView.
- Reviewer decision note on Refund, separate from Refund.note (which holds the requester's own text, so it is never shown as the team's note).
- Captured and refund summary, refund state and delivered_at on OrderSummary.
- Refund amount and state on order.items_adjusted.
- customer_cancel_reason on OrderCustomerView.
- Reorder operation for past orders (a later release). An unpaid order's items go back in the cart with the existing cart operations instead.
- Proof-of-delivery photo for the customer.
- Ask for a second look (grievance).
- Receipt PDF and share.
- Rider distance to customer (map fallback), optional.
- Order-history search (filed as GitHub issue 148).
- Restaurant address on OrderRestaurantRef or OrderTracking (the map text fallback names the restaurant only), optional.
- ETA window on order.eta_updated (today the app re-fetches getOrderTracking), only if a refetch is not acceptable.
- handover_method on OrderCustomerView (the left-at-door headline says only "Delivered"), optional.

s5.text:
Icons for the coding team

These Solar icons are used here but are not yet in packages/ui-web/src/primitives/solar-icon-map.json or the native map: info, warning, error, lock, refresh, minus, more, chevron-right. Adding these eight ids to both maps is a prerequisite in the build hand-off for this app: without them the Icon renders nothing (ICON_NAME_UNKNOWN).

Proposed components for owner approval (drawn, built only from library parts plus HalalGoes components and tokens):
- InlineAlert: HalalGoes Card (outlined) + Icon + type-label-lg / type-body-md; shadcn/ui Alert on web, React Native Reusables Alert on native.
- Textarea: shadcn/ui Textarea / RNR Textarea; --border-interactive at rest, 2px --focus-ring border when focused (no ring), 2px --feedback-danger-border plus the ring when invalid and focused.
- StickyFooter: surface-raised with --elev-sticky holding Buttons.
- ListItem: a pressable row (shadcn/ui or RNR) with Icon chevron-right and type-label-lg / type-body-sm.
- QuantityStepper: the IconButton pair plus an "n of m" label.
- Skeleton: shadcn/ui Skeleton / RNR Skeleton on --skeleton-base, inside HalalGoes Cards.
- EmptyState and ErrorState: Icon + heading + Button.

Component gaps (not drawn): MapView, Avatar, FileUpload, a bar-only Countdown (no m:ss), StatusTimeline offline and polling connection states, Chip, a text-size scaling token for native Dynamic Type (type roles are fixed px).

Design-system ask: StatusTimeline (and every design-system time formatter) uses the app's 12-hour formatter, output "7:10 pm" (lowercase, no periods). Today it formats its own times with Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA'), which renders "7:10 p.m.". Until then, the boards that show timeline times carry "Component gap: StatusTimeline time format (renders p.m.)": Track-FullScroll, Track-3DS, Cancel-WindowClosed, Outcome-Disputed, Outcome-Disputed-Delivery, Outcome-Disputed-Restaurant.

s6.text:
Orders: row badge for each OrderState

CREATED, AUTHORIZED: Placing
RESTAURANT_PENDING: Waiting for restaurant
PREPARING: Being prepared
READY_FOR_PICKUP: Ready
PICKED_UP: On the way
ARRIVED: At your door
DELIVERED: Delivered
COMPLETED: Completed
DISPUTED: Under review (listed under Active because it is not terminal, but it does not count as the one active order; owner decision 1 October)
RESOLVED: Resolved
CANCELLED: Cancelled
REJECTED: Not accepted
FAILED: Payment failed

Active states use the info badge, except DISPUTED; the rest are neutral. Only REJECTED and FAILED say "Not charged". CANCELLED and RESOLVED show no amount, only "See details for your money": OrderSummary cannot tell a voided cancel from a refunded one, or a refunded resolution from a declined one, and a bare total reads as money taken (Needs API: captured and refund summary on OrderSummary). If an amount must show, it is labelled "Order total". Every row also has "{item_count} items · {first_item_names}", wrapping, never truncated. Every past row: Details + the design system Menu ("Actions for order {code} from {restaurant}").

The Active section comes from listOrders(status_group=ACTIVE). getActiveOrder and 409 ACTIVE_ORDER_EXISTS exclude DISPUTED (contract description change: getActiveOrder says "the one active order" with no exception). The Orders badge in the bottom navigation counts the orders listed under Active, an order under review included (Orders-Disputed and every Outcome-Disputed board show 1).

s8.text:
Get help: where each path ends

- My order is late: an explainer from data the app has (ETA, deadline_at, what happens then).
- Report a problem (owner decision, 1 October): from acceptance, with reasons that fit before delivery: very late, wrong address, want to cancel (GetHelp-Report-Early; a wrong address or something else makes the note required: GetHelp-Report-Early-Required). A person reviews it; nothing changes the address or cancels by itself. While it is open the tracking screen shows a "Your report" card (Track-ReportOpen-Early), and Report a problem opens GetHelp-Refund-AlreadyRequested.
- A halal concern before delivery: an explainer; the halal report opens from DELIVERED.
- Something else: Call us while the phone line is open. Outside phone hours the server switches support off and GetHelp-Contact-Closed shows the hours and lists the self-serve help for the order's state instead of a dead end.
- After delivery, every report row works at any hour: that list is the out-of-hours path.
- Disputed and refund-delayed outcomes show the review deadline and "We'll let you know" instead of Get help; the restaurant-can't-finish outcome adds Call us.

s9.text:
Halal badge on order cards

- Before DELIVERED (every tracking board from CREATED to ARRIVED, plus cancel and get help): the outlined restaurant card shows HalalBadge surface="card" size="sm" from OrderRestaurantRef.halal. CERTIFIED and EXPIRING_SOON (Track-Waiting-ExpiringSoon) as the design system draws them; EXPIRED in cool slate, never red (Track-CertLapsed, next to the neutral notice). Missing field: no badge at all (Track-Waiting-NoHalal).
- From DELIVERED on, and on every terminal, DISPUTED or outcome board and the receipt: no badge. The field is the restaurant's state now, not at order time, so it could put an Expired badge beside food already eaten, or a Certified one beside a halal complaint.
- A certificate revoked mid-order: display_state UNVERIFIED, so no badge, plus one neutral notice ("no longer verified by HalalGoes"), never a danger colour (Track-CertRevoked).
- A certificate that lapses mid-order: one neutral notice plus the slate Expired badge (Track-CertLapsed), then the same no-badge card after delivery (Track-Delivered-CertLapsed).
- Offline: the badge comes from the cached order only while that copy is 15 minutes old or less; older, it is removed and one neutral line says it returns online (Track-Offline-HalalStale).
